title: Keep slash-command arguments when the prompt template has no $ARGUMENTS slot
outcome:
Reported by Engram::Opus (2026-09-26, review round 5, 14:02-14:04 local). termal_spawn_session (mode reviewer, readOnly) was called with a one-line prompt: "/review-code Round 5 of ... fingerprint ... manifest ...". TermAl expanded .claude/commands/review-code.md, which has no $ARGUMENTS slot, and dropped the rest of the line without any warning, so neither reviewer received the freeze literal. Affected: delegations b92ccea8 (Codex, session-7811) and 70c7be9a (Claude, session-7812). Workaround used: a multi-line brief telling the child to read the command file (delegation b574dd1d).

Mechanism, confirmed in code: src/workspace_queries.rs resolve_agent_command_payload, PromptTemplate branch. It runs content.split("$ARGUMENTS").join(arguments), so a template without the placeholder loses the arguments.

Wanted: arguments are never dropped silently. Either append them to the expanded prompt when the template has no slot, or refuse the request with an error that names the command. Acceptance: a unit test where a template without $ARGUMENTS plus non-empty arguments either keeps the arguments or returns an error; nothing is lost silently.
